extracted.intended_audience: members of the public and grassroots activists who want to get involved with 350.org climate campaigns
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for people who want to participate in 350.org's climate-justice movement, offering actions organized by location and time-commitment and routes to join, register, or form local groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select your location
rubrics_metrics.description: Select your geographic region (Worldwide, Africa, Australia, Canada, Caribbean, East Asia, Europe, Latin America, New Zealand, Pacific, South Asia, Türkiye, US) to find locally relevant actions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choosing your location filters appropriate campaigns, groups, and contacts so you can join or act on region-specific initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choose actions by time commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: How much time do you have? Options: A Few Minutes, A Bit More Time, I'm Ready For More.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pick actions matched to the time you can spare — the site groups activities under these three time-commitment headings to help volunteers pick suitable tasks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Join a local group (if one exists)
rubrics_metrics.description: Search our global map and check if a local group already exists near you. You can get in touch and join them!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the global map to find nearby groups, contact them to participate, and immediately plug into local organizing and events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Register an existing local group with 350
rubrics_metrics.description: Do you already participate in a local climate justice group, and want to connect with the 350 network? Send your application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your group already exists independently, apply to register it with 350 to join the broader network and access resources/support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form a new local group
rubrics_metrics.description: If there is no local group near you, you can start your own. 350 can help you to form a new group in your area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the 'Learn More' guidance to get support from 350 on forming an organizing group, recruitment, and initial activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Short digital actions / petitions (A Few Minutes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Call for clean energy now — Demand World Bank leadership supports a clean and just transition to renewable energy. Tell Marsh: Drop EACOP — Call on Marsh not to insure the East Africa Crude Oil Pipeline. Add your name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quick actions include signing petitions and digital asks to institutions/companies; these are framed as immediate ways to exert pressure and show public support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spread the word via social media
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow us on social media and help amplify the stories of our movement with your friends and family! (Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, Youtube).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use social platforms to share campaign content and personal stories to increase reach and public awareness; follow 350 channels to stay updated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Skill up your activism (A Bit More Time)
rubrics_metrics.description: On our Trainings website you'll find resources and online courses to help you deepen your activism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Investing time in trainings builds skills for effective organizing, campaigning, and storytelling; follow links to specific courses and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tell your story / Climate Storytellers
rubrics_metrics.description: Report about climate, tell your story — Telling stories is a powerful tool to inspire action! Join our community of Climate Storytellers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contribute personal or local climate stories to motivate others; guidance includes joining the storytelling community and resources for crafting narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Become a monthly donor / donate
rubrics_metrics.description: Become a monthly donor. Your support helps us build a strong movement. Chip in today!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial contributions — especially recurring monthly donations — are framed as substantive ways to support organizing, campaigns, and infrastructure.

rubrics_metrics.name: If you can't find an option, tell 350 what you need
rubrics_metrics.description: Looking for more? Didn't find an option for you? Let us know what you were looking for.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the feedback/contact option to request other forms of involvement or to get help finding suitable opportunities; encourages two-way engagement.
